text: Fixed: `Context.FileAttachment` now escapes quotes/backslashes in the filename for the ASCII branch (`escapeQuotes` helper added in context.go), so a filename containing `"` can no longer break out of the `filename="..."` parameter. Full test suite still green.

Fixed: `findCaseInsensitivePathRec` in tree.go was descending into `n.children[0]` for the wildcard child, but the wildcard child is always the last element (see `addChild`); with a param plus literal children it panicked / returned wrong paths. Now uses `n.children[len(n.children)-1]`. Full test suite still green.

Fixed: `Context.NegotiateFormat` panicked with "index out of range" when an accepted format was longer than an offered one (e.g. Accept: text/html, offer "text"). The comparison loop is now bounded by both lengths. Full test suite still green.

Still investigating: `Error.Unwrap`/`Error.Error` in errors.go look correct for errors.Is/As, so I'm probing further for the actual divergence (the existing TestErrorUnwrap passes). Will report when fixed.
Still investigating: `responseWriter.WriteHeader`/`Status()` in response_writer.go match the documented behaviour, so I'm probing for the actual status-code divergence. Will report when fixed.
Still investigating: params returned by the router look correct for the cases I probed, so I'm narrowing down the "params must not be empty" case in tree.go. Will report when fixed.
